description: Hybrid post-quantum cryptography for Python: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, hybrid envelopes and signatures, migration tooling.
rules: Pass a context when signing and the same expected context when verifying.
Pass aad when sealing an envelope and expected_aad when opening it.
The default hybrid signature suite is Ed25519+ML-DSA-65-v2; the default hybrid KEM is X25519+ML-KEM-768.
